label: Schedule I sandboxes
description: How Schedule I sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: mo2.

notes: MelonLoader is not a mod and is not installed here; install it into the game folder once. Mods go in the Mods folder it creates.
Some mods also need files in UserLibs or Plugins; those are not handled by this single-file rule.
Hard links are the default: nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod, and every file is still a real file to the game.
